title: Sign-up, sign-in and sign-out screens with session handling; check sessions on a preview from a phone (spike S4)
acceptance: Sign-up rejects a password under 12 characters;A registered user can sign in and sign out;Protected API routes reject an unauthenticated request;The session survives a reload on the preview in Chrome on Android

title: Create a trip with origin hub, duration, budget and radius (T1)
acceptance: An authenticated organiser can create a trip from a curated origin hub;Duration, budget and radius reject zero or negative values against the field;Creation records T1 through the trip state machine;The organiser and trip parameters are persisted

title: Shareable invitation link, join flow and roster (T2)
acceptance: The organiser can create a shareable invitation link;An authenticated invitee can join through an active link;Joining records T2 through the trip state machine;A duplicate join does not create a second roster entry;The dashboard shows the updated roster

title: Preference form; a submission records T3 or I1
acceptance: Budget minimum above maximum is rejected against the field;A date window in the past or with start after end is rejected;A valid profile is stored only for its submitting member;Submission records T3 when all required members have submitted and I1 otherwise

title: Trip dashboard with submission status and a 10-second poll
acceptance: The dashboard displays every roster member's submission status;The dashboard polls for updates every 10 seconds;A changed status appears without a manual reload;The layout remains usable at 360 pixels

title: Access rules: a profile is readable only by its owner; the group sees aggregates
acceptance: An owner can read their own preference profile;Another group member cannot read the profile;The group can read only aggregate preferences;An unauthenticated request is rejected;Integration tests exercise both allowed and forbidden access

title: Administrator catalogue re-import endpoint and administrator role
acceptance: Only an administrator can invoke catalogue re-import;A non-administrator receives a forbidden response;Import validates catalogue rows before persistence;Repeated imports update or preserve rows without duplicates;The response reports inserted and updated counts

title: Wireframes for the five SRS 3.1.1 screens at 360 px and desktop
acceptance: Wireframes cover the trip dashboard and preference form;Wireframes cover shortlist, package comparison and itinerary views;Each screen has a 360-pixel and desktop version;Costs show group and per-person estimates;Constraint meaning is not conveyed by colour alone
